title: Online Orders Promotion Register
content:
Only the codes in this register exist for Online Orders. A code not listed here is not a Marlowe & Finch promotion code.

| Code | Discount | Applies to | Minimum spend (USD) | Valid |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| WELCOME15 | 15% off | Regular-price lines | 0.00 | The customer's first order only |
| SHIPFREE | Free-shipping entitlement | The order's shipping fee | 0.00 | 1 January 2026 to 31 December 2026 |
| FALLEDIT20 | 20% off | Regular-price apparel and footwear lines | 100.00 | 18 September 2026 to 12 October 2026 |
| BOOTS40 | 40.00 off | Regular-price footwear lines | 200.00 | 1 October 2026 to 1 November 2026 |
| FRIENDS25 | 25% off | Regular-price and clearance lines | 0.00 | 12 November 2026 to 16 November 2026 |

## First order, for WELCOME15

An order is the customer's first order when the customer has no earlier order, across all of their history before the order being placed, in any status other than cancelled. Earlier orders that were cancelled do not count; earlier orders in any other status do.

| Customer's earlier orders | First order for WELCOME15 |
|---|---|
| None | Yes |
| One, cancelled | Yes |
| One, delivered | No |
| Two cancelled and one still placed | No |

## Reading the register

- FRIENDS25 is the one code in the register that reaches clearance lines; every other merchandise code is limited to regular-price lines.
- SHIPFREE discounts no merchandise: it gives the order a free-shipping entitlement on its shipping fee.
- FALLEDIT20 and BOOTS40 carry a minimum spend; WELCOME15, SHIPFREE and FRIENDS25 have none.
- WELCOME15 has no calendar dates; its validity turns on the order being the customer's first.
